name: Topology/Normal Consistency Loss
definition: Computes a loss to enforce consistency between predicted triangle probabilities, connectivity, and surface normals in a learned marching cubes network.
summary: Topology/Normal Consistency Loss is a differentiable regularization term that enforces watertight manifold meshes by penalizing inconsistent triangle probabilities and normals, differing from deterministic deciders by being probabilistic and gradient-based.
